explanation: Jumbo was a huge African elephant at London Zoo. P. T. Barnum bought him in 1882 and toured him across North America, and the Boeing 747 became the jumbo jet long after.

claims.text: The word 'jumbo' was popularized by Jumbo, a famous elephant at London Zoo and later in P. T. Barnum's circus.
'Jumbo' was not popularized by a jet airliner, an ocean liner or a circus giant; the jumbo jet was named after the word.
Jumbo was an African elephant kept at London Zoo.
P. T. Barnum bought Jumbo in 1882 and toured him in North America.
The Boeing 747 was nicknamed the jumbo jet, long after the elephant.
